pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with moderately sharp pixel gradients. The patches exhibit a hierarchical size distribution, with larger, more elongated geometries on the mid-flank and smaller, more fragmented shapes towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more patches converge. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the flank, with some narrowing observed at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated contour is visible along the dorsal mane of the neck, characterized by a high frequency of short, vertical hair clusters against the background.
